scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix admin
scripts.api:up: docker rm -f react-chat-bot-api 2>nul & docker run -d --name react-chat-bot-api -p 3001:3001 --env-file .env -e DATABASE_URL=postgresql://chatbot:chatbot@host.docker.internal:5432/chatbot react-chat-bot-api
scripts.admin:up: docker rm -f react-chat-bot-admin 2>nul & docker run -d --name react-chat-bot-admin -p 3002:3002 --env-file .env -e DATABASE_URL=postgresql://chatbot:chatbot@host.docker.internal:5432/chatbot -v "%cd%/admin/uploads:/app/uploads" react-chat-bot-admin
